asset_types_public_name_check.name: asset_types_public_name_check
asset_types_public_name_check.value: "asset_types"."public_name" is null or char_length("asset_types"."public_name") between 1 and 60

bill_lines_reason_check.name: bill_lines_reason_check
bill_lines_reason_check.value: "bill_lines"."kind" not in ('discount', 'other') or "bill_lines"."reason" is not null

rental_items_one_active_per_asset.name: rental_items_one_active_per_asset
rental_items_one_active_per_asset.where: "rental_items"."asset_id" is not null and "rental_items"."released_at" is null

rental_items_target_check.name: rental_items_target_check
rental_items_target_check.value: ("rental_items"."asset_id" is not null and "rental_items"."variant_id" is null and "rental_items"."quantity" = 1) or ("rental_items"."asset_id" is null and "rental_items"."variant_id" is not null and "rental_items"."quantity" > 0)

media_purge_idx.name: media_purge_idx
media_purge_idx.where: "media"."deleted_at" is null and "media"."delete_after" is not null
